data.desc: Aquestive is a biopharmaceutical company advancing medicines to bring meaningful improvement to patients' lives through innovative science. The worldwide leader in delivering trusted, quality medications on oral film, Aquestive develops proprietary pharmaceutical products and operates U.S.-based manufacturing facilities in Indiana, with its headquarters in New Jersey. The Company is the exclusive manufacturer of four commercialized products marketed by its licensees across six continents using proprietary, best-in-class technologies like PharmFilm. Aquestive's AdrenaVerse platform contains a library of more than 20 epinephrine prodrugs enabling the pursuit of various potential allergy and dermatological indications. The Company is advancing Anaphylm (dibutepinephrine) sublingual film for the treatment of severe allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis, and AQST-108 (epinephrine) topical gel for various potential dermatological conditions.
